message: Cannot pass the expression '{0}' to the 'out' or 'ref' parameter '{1}' of method '{2}' because the expression is not a variable.
title: Cannot pass an expression that is not a variable to an out or ref parameter.
rationale: The current text states that the error is caused by the parameter being 'out' or 'ref', which suggests that such parameters can never receive an argument. DeclarationExtensions.GetArguments (DeclarationExtensions.cs:186-194) reports it only when the argument is known not to be referenceable, for instance a property or the result of an invocation, so the message must point at the expression.
